verdict.rationale: mise lets you redirect where tools come from. The `http:` backend accepts arbitrary per-platform download URLs with checksums, which could point at an internal mirror, and `MISE_BACKENDS_<TOOL>` overrides which backend or plugin source a tool resolves to. Nothing in the evidence addresses authentication, scoped or otherwise. Missing for 10: any documented credential/token configuration for private registries, auth scoped per registry or host, first-class mirror/registry URL settings for backends like npm, pipx or aqua, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
